plan.notes: Practical Nursing Step-Out Certificate — 'Program Course Pathway Effective Fall 2024' (official, mohave.edu). An Arizona State Board of Nursing-approved option for current AAS Nursing students wishing to step out of the RN program and gain employment as a practical nurse; students must be accepted to the AAS Nursing program to declare it. Completes in 2 semesters, so it is seeded as collected with program_type 'professional-phase' per convention (documented, pipeline-excluded). Sequenced sum = 24 (12+12); the pathway prints no total-credits figure. External prereqs (excluded from total, documented): BIO 181 (0-4) — waived to 0 for students transferring in BIO 201, BIO 202 and/or BIO 205; BIO 201 (4); BIO 202 (4); CHM 130 or higher (4); ENG 101 (3); MAT 142 or higher (3-4); PSY 101 or PSY 245 (3). NUR 101 'Fundamentals of Nursing Education' (2) is confirmed by the official AAS Nursing pathway (Effective Fall 2025); remaining NUR titles verified against the 2026-27 Course Package Inventory (N-R). Sequence content verified from the official PDF's indexed text (direct fetch returned a transient upstream timeout; the mohave.edu-hosted document text is quoted verbatim in the notes' sources).
